reasoning: Every successful canonical creation path validates reported ERC-721 support, stores one prize contract/token ID, requires the exact deposit callback, and verifies clone custody before activation. The raffle then sells ranged entries, authenticates and filters the draw callback, selects a winning entry, proves its ticket, and on NftWon transfers the same configured NFT to the current ticket owner with an ownership postcondition. Cash and refund outcomes use the separate sponsor-return path and do not substitute a non-NFT on the NftWon branch. The concrete external prize contract’s semantic honesty remains a documented dependency assumption, not a missing local implementation path.
